articles.title: Lost in 1950, Korean War Soldier to be Laid to Rest in Illinois
articles.summary: The remains of U.S. Army Pfc. John R. Stovall, 22, who was killed during the Korean War, will be interred at Mount Hope Cemetery in Belleville, Illinois. Services and interment are being coordinated by Kassly Funeral Home.

articles.title: Army Activates Air Defense Guam Battalion Focused on Chinese, North Korean Threats
articles.summary: The U.S. Army’s recently activated a Guam-based air defense battalion meant to protect the island from increasingly advanced air and missile threats fielded by China and North Korea. The 3rd Battalion, 43rd Air Defense Artillery Regiment, activated on Oct. 16, will inherit the defense of Guam responsibilities of Task Force Talon.

articles.title: US Air Force wants AI to assist aerial refueling
articles.summary: The goal is for AI to automatically analyze refueling operations from cameras mounted on the tankers and provide “hot wash” feedback to the tanker crews.

articles.title: AMC honors 10 civilian and military personnel driving workplace excellence

These awards recognize outstanding individual contributions that directly drive workplace productivity, employee retention, and overall mission readiness across the enterprise.

articles.title: From Arrest to Advocacy: Aberdeen Proving Ground Employee Shares Journey to Recovery
articles.summary: For Michelle Twist, a U.S. Army Garrison Aberdeen Proving Ground employee, that moment came in 2015. articles.title: U.S., Japanese forces strengthen bilateral readiness through hot-pit refueling during Keen Sword 27

articles.title: Exercise Beverly Sunrise 27-01

The exercise tested their ability to respond to simulated threats, sustain operations and project combat power in contested environments.
